verdict.rationale: Both changes completely remove compact parsing, configuration, rendering, and user-facing documentation while preserving the remaining behavior. B has a small testing advantage: its integration regression test verifies rejection of both --compact and -c, whereas A checks only --compact at that level. Otherwise, the implementations are effectively identical, and both reports describe the changes and claimed verification adequately.
a_issues: The integration regression test checks only --compact; rejection of -c is covered only by the parser unit test.
